practice.title: Write an Email: revisión de una calificación
practice.prompt:
**Situation.** You received your grade for the midterm report in the course *Environmental Systems*. You believe that one of your answers was marked incorrectly, because the feedback says you did not include a source, but you did cite it on page 3.

**Write an email to your teaching assistant, Mr. Collins.** In your email:
- Explain which grade or comment you want to discuss.
- Describe why you think the comment may be a mistake.
- Ask politely whether he could review your report and say when you could meet.
practice.vocab:
- *I am writing regarding…* · *I would like to ask whether…*
- *I believe there may be a misunderstanding.*
- *As you can see on page 3…* · *I have attached a copy.*
- *Would you be able to review…?* · *I would be grateful if…*
- *I am available on… / Please let me know what time suits you.*
practice.template:
1. **Greeting**: Dear Mr. Collins,
2. **Purpose**: I am writing regarding the feedback on my midterm report.
3. **Detail**: The comment says… / However, on page 3 I…
4. **Request + availability**: Would you be able to… / I am free on…
5. **Close**: Thank you for your time. Kind regards, Name
checklist: Propósito claro en la primera oración
Los tres puntos del enunciado cubiertos
practice.model:
Dear Mr. Collins,

I am writing regarding the feedback on my midterm report for Environmental Systems. The comment on question 4 says that I did not include a source for my data on river pollution.

However, I believe there may be a misunderstanding, because I cited the 2021 national water report on page 3, and I listed it in the reference list as well. I have attached a copy of the report in case it is useful.

Would you be able to review my answer again? I am available on Tuesday after 3:00 p.m. or on Wednesday morning, if you would like to discuss it in person.

Thank you very much for your time.

Kind regards,
María Fernández
practice.modelNotes: **Por qué funciona:** cubre los 3 puntos en 3 párrafos, usa fórmulas corteses (*Would you be able to…*), da un dato concreto (página 3) y propone dos horarios.

quiz.q: Which sentence is the most appropriate for an email to a professor you do not know well?
options: Hey, can you give me more time?
I was wondering whether it would be possible to receive a short extension.
I want more time for the essay.
quiz.explain: «I was wondering whether it would be possible…» es cortés y formal.

quiz.q: Which closing is appropriate in a formal email?
quiz.explain: Kind regards / Sincerely / Best regards son cierres formales.
